message:
We've all been there: the moment we need our phone or tech the most, and it decides to go dark on us. That's why having a plan in place is so important, especially for our kids. 🧒

Preparedness isn't just about having supplies; it's about knowing what to do when things don't go as expected. This resource offers some great tips for teaching our little ones about safety and readiness in a fun and engaging way. 

What’s your go-to tip for keeping kids prepared and calm in unexpected situations?
